title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 20 | The Enchanted Grove | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
The flowers of the Enchanted Grove are wilting. Mori the Druid joins the party to heal the forest, the grumpy Thornbush Treant blooms again, and the friends plant a garden together at sunset.

0:00 The Wilting Grove
0:45 Mori the Druid
1:30 The Thornbush Treant
2:15 Planting at Sunset

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
